summary: Integra Resources Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Q1 2026 operational update for its Florida Canyon Mine. The report discloses record mining rates (76,800 tpd), gold production of 12,635 ounces, a $61M bought-deal public offering completed in Q1 2026, and strengthened balance sheet. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is announced. The filing is a routine operational and financing update by a foreign private issuer.
